prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(no tests finished yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Delay Sign-In After Pet Creation: Move the sign-in step to after adoption certificate creation so users form an emotional attachment to their pet before signing up. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early and takes a mean time of 567s. Letting users create their pet first builds motivation to sign in.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Selection Stage: Redesign the pet selection screen into a visual stage layout with interactive pet choice cards and personality badges. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and takes a long median time of 89s and mean time of 1017s.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Interactive Guide: Insert a new onboarding screen before home intro showing users key desktop shortcuts to summon, hide, and talk to their pet. (why: Support received multiple emails about confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, and finish conversion is only 64.8%.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Restores & Sync Hint: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen informing users how to log back into existing accounts to preserve saved pets. (why: Support received 8 emails (the largest complaint category) about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Status & Diagnostics: Show progress and desktop rendering status updates on the waiting screen so users know their pet is initializing. (why: Home step waiting time has a median of 201s / mean 2336s, and support had 3 reports of pets failing to show up on desktop.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Onboarding Roadmap Checklist: Change choose_path layout to a checklist displaying the step counter and progress track. (why: Choose path takes a mean time of 514s; presenting a structured checklist sets clear expectations for remaining steps.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Quick Controls Tip Carousel: Add a tip carousel to the home intro screen providing actionable tips on controlling desktop pet behaviors. (why: Support noted multiple post-onboarding confusion emails regarding controlling and hiding desktop pets.)
7: [sign_in, notification] Account Privacy & Deletion Notice: Include a body notice on the sign-in screen reassuring users about data privacy and easy account deletion options. (why: Support received 4 emails requesting account or personal data deletion post-onboarding.)
